newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Futuris bids for rest of Farmers Trust.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Futuris bids for rest of Farmers Trust.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Futuris Corp Ltd said it proposed to bid for the 2.8 percent of unlisted Farmers Investment Trust (FIT) that it did not already hold.
Futuris said it will offer 2,072 Futuris shares and A$523 cash for every 2,000 FIT units held.
Based on Wednesday's closing price for Futuris shares of A$1.61, the offer would value each FIT unit at about A$1.93.
Futuris said that following its recent takeover offer for rural group Elders Australia Ltd, it was now entitled to 83.21 percent of the shares in Elders.
This entitlement included the 14.64 percent of the shares in Elders held by FIT because Futuris holds 97.2 percent of the units in FIT.
Futuris said it made the offer because it was mindful of the position of the 122 minority unitholders in FIT.

It said the consideration has been calculated in order to put a FIT unitholder in a comparable position to that he would have been in if he held a pro-rata entitlement in the Elders shares held by FIT and had accepted the Futuris bid.

If all the minority unitholders accept the Futuris offer, this will result in the issue of a further 723,500 ordinary shares in the capital of Futuris representing about 0.17 percent of the issued capital, it said.
